subject: LiveWest Summit - Onsite incident: power + speaker contingency and booth repair
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vertex Events <ops@vertexevents.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: LiveWest Summit - contingency plan for power/internet + speaker fallback

Team —

Two logistical notes as we head into LiveWest next week (booth 12, main hall):
1) Venue told Vertex yesterday they flagged a flaky power feed on the east wall (panel A). Vertex is lining up a generator and a technician; their ops lead is cc'd.
2) Our keynote (Sara Liu) is traveling through a route with weather delays; we should plan for a no-show scenario and a 10-min technical hiccup fallback.

Action items I want before we go live on Monday morning:
- Marcus: confirm we have a UPS at the demo rack and a quick power-reroute diagram (attach).
- Dev: create a short fallback slide + pre-recorded 4-minute demo clip we can play if live demo fails. Store on local USB and our offline laptop.
- Grace/Laura: draft two customer-facing lines for booth staff if the keynote is delayed/no-show (one for 1:1s, one for stage attendees).
- Vertex: confirm generator ETA and on-site tech contact mobile.

I attached the vendor contact sheet and our booth layout. Keep replies short — we'll use this thread as the event incident log if anything goes sideways.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: vendor_contact_sheet.pdf, booth_layout_sketch.jpg

From: Vertex Events <ops@vertexevents.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 12:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: LiveWest Summit - contingency plan for power/internet + speaker fallback

Hi Tessa —

Confirmed: generator reserved for Booths 10-14, ETA on-site for install Sunday 18:00 local. Ops lead Jose Martinez (mobile: +1 702-555-0123) will be present for immediate reroutes. We'll also bring a spare 3kVA UPS we can chain to your demo rack.

If you want wire runs to the aisle power post, we'll bill as an after-hours labor item — we'll flag costs in the on-site change order.

We recommend the pre-recorded demo on USB and a second laptop for failover.

— Vertex Events Ops

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vertex Events <ops@vertexevents.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 07:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Onsite: power fluctuation observed — generator being dialed in

On-site update from booth 12 — 07:10 local:
- Noticed 2 dips (250ms) on the east feed this morning; demo rack moved to UPS (on battery) at 06:50.
- Vertex plugged generator feed and verified stable output at 06:58. Tech Jose is running a burn test now.
- One demo laptop (demo-2) lost connection to our internal sync server when the dip occurred; switching to local file copy now.

For Dev: please confirm the pre-recorded demo playbook (which USB file to use) and where to point the local laptop for the demo.

For Logistics: we should request a written change order for the generator labor so finance has an audit trail.

Marcus
Sr. Events Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite: power fluctuation observed — generator being dialed in

Marcus —
Thanks for the heads up. Use file demo_highlights_v3.mp4 on USB A (labelled REDWOOD_DEMO) for the backup play. Local laptop should run the playback from the USB and mirror to the auxiliary HDMI, not rely on network shares. Grace: booth staff should be told to swap to backup player at the first sign of lag.

I also uploaded a 4-minute audio track of the voiceover to the same USB in case the presenter connection is unstable.

Dev
Senior Engineer, Integrations

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LiveWest Summit - Onsite incident: power + speaker contingency and booth repair

Quick note from the floor — 09:35 local:
- Sara Liu (keynote) called at 08:50: flight diverted, she is stuck and cannot make the 10:00 slot. 
- Venue stage coordinator asked if we could provide a 10-minute lightning talk to fill the slot; they'd give us 5 mins on stage and a 5-min Q&A.

Suggested staging:
- Offer the stage a pre-recorded 4-min demo + live Q&A with Laura and me fielding questions. If stage control requires a speaker, we'll have Marcus introduce us.
- For booth visitors, use the customer line: "Sara had an unexpected travel delay — we'll run a short live demo at the main stage and have a 1:1 deep dive at the booth any time this afternoon."

I'll coordinate with stage ops and confirm AV handoff.

Grace
Field Sales Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Vertex Events <ops@vertexevents.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, LVCC Tech Support <techsupport@lvcc.org>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 20:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-incident wrap and next steps (generator charge, vendor change order, postmortem)

Thanks everyone for the fast pivots today. Final notes to close the incident: 
1) Generator: Vertex confirmed burn test passed at 10:30 and the UPS maintained the demo rack during the dip window. Vertex to send signed change order for after-hours labor and generator rental; finance needs the document for approval.
2) Speaker: Sara recorded a short apology video which we played on stage; stage ops credited our slot at no additional cost. We collected three high-priority demo leads for follow-up (Emily Ross / Acme was one).
3) Booth repair: minor gaffer tape on a loose panel; Marcus logged photos (booth_repair_11may.jpg) — Vertex handled the fix.
4) Follow-up items for our team:
   - Finance: expect vendor invoice and change order; Tessa to approve once I verify amounts.
   - Ops/Eng: Dev + Marcus to produce a 1-page incident postmortem using the attached template and include network/power mitigation checklist.
   - Sales: Grace/Laura to send personalized outreach to the three high-priority leads captured at 13:00.

I'll collect everything into a postmortem doc by EOD Wednesday. If anyone has photos, call sheets, or additional cost notes, add them to the Drive folder (link below).

Thanks — that went smoother than it could have. Good job.

Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: postmortem-template.docx
Related Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/LiveWest/postmortem
